item.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Get Reserved Node Exchange Offerings

request.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Get Reserved Node Exchange Offerings

description.content: Returns an array of DC2 ReservedNodeOfferings that matches the payment type, term, and usage price of the given DC1 reserved node.

query.description: (Required) A string representing the node identifier for the DC1 Reserved Node to be exchanged.
An integer setting the maximum number of ReservedNodeOfferings to retrieve.
A value that indicates the starting point for the next set of ReservedNodeOfferings.
